{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify deduplication worked
print("Deduplicated shape:", df_dedup.shape)
print("Duplicate patient_id count after dedup:", df_dedup['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_df = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check response in treatment arm
print("Number of patients in treatment arm:", len(treatment_df))
print("Responded distribution in treatment arm:", treatment_df['responded'].value_counts(dropna=False))

# Compute fraction responded
fraction_responded = treatment_df['responded'].mean()
print(f"Fraction responded in treatment arm: {fraction_responded}")"}
